name: Concept-Trigger Law
rule: saying 'I want to make a new app' auto-creates a hashtag-verb-noun concept
process: 1) find the word the user is using to commission the app, 2) look up the Merriam-Webster definition, 3) recite the definitions and sentences, 4) qualify which sense applies, 5) assign the number and subscript, 6) place it under the app title as the short description
